title: Per-move-frame routing_rebuild leaks temp-arena memory cumulatively across the session
evidence:
app/main.odin:379: 			app.preview_live = rnd.preview_compute(&app.preview_scratch, &app.state.topology,
app/render/assist.odin:280: 	pp.routing_rebuild(&s.rt, &s.topo, cat)
core/routing.odin:127-130: 	dist := make([]i32, int(n), context.temp_allocator)    // dist-to-dst per node slot (cost units)
	settled := make([]bool, int(n), context.temp_allocator) // settled per node slot
	seen := make([]bool, int(n), context.temp_allocator)    // per-(u,d) neighbor dedup
	min_cost := make([]i32, int(n), context.temp_allocator) // per-(u,d) neighbor MIN edge cost
(app/ contains no free_all/arena_reset call — verified by grep)
detail: Every drag-move frame rebuilds the routing table; its Dijkstra scratch (dist/settled/seen/min_cost) is temp-arena-allocated and the app never free_all's. Growth is cumulative across all drags and runs — unbounded, contradicting the PR body's "bounded per drag".
recommended_fix: Call free_all(context.temp_allocator) once per frame after handle_input, or give routing_rebuild an explicit scratch arena the app resets; alternatively recompute the preview only when the snap position changes.

title: Graduation nudge persists on the frozen Game_Over screen where its dismiss key (T) is dead
detail: The nudge draws in draw_hud regardless of mode. In Game_Over ticks freeze, so the nudge line stays on the game-over screen up to nudge_ticks, and handle_input's Game_Over early-return makes the T press that would dismiss it a no-op.
recommended_fix: Gate the nudge draw on app.mode == .Run like the R3 glow, or clear nudge_until when the run goes terminal.
